title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
title_zh: 嵌入预测助力图像生成

paragraphs.en: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction , and in Embedding Conditioned Generation , a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL , reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.
paragraphs.zh: 在扩散变换器中，类别标签或文本提示只需嵌入一次，然后在每次去噪步骤中重复使用相同的条件。 我们提出一个问题：预测的嵌入是否可以替代这一条件？ 下一嵌入预测自回归（NEPA）训练一个Transformer模型，以预测序列中的下一个连续嵌入。 在生成过程中，干净图像紧随噪声图像之后，因此其嵌入是条件与噪声图像之后的下一个嵌入。 我们通过多嵌入预测训练一个NEPA模型来一次性预测所有这些嵌入；在嵌入条件生成中，DiT生成器以这些预测为条件，并在每次去噪步骤中重新计算，从而使得条件信号能够适应当前的噪声状态。 在类别条件化的ImageNet 256 × 256数据集上的实验研究了生成器的条件、多嵌入预测的设计以及两个模型的扩展性。 NEPA模型为每个采样步骤增加了一个第二网络；借助这一设计，并结合REPA，我们的最终模型NEPA-DiT-XL在仅使用约三分之一REPA训练计算量的情况下，达到了1.32的FID值。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion transformers have become the standard backbone for image generation ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) . Across these models, the condition enters through a fixed interface: a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. It is left to the generator to work out what the condition implies for the image at hand as its state moves from noise to a clean sample. Recent work brings pretrained visual representations into this pipeline, as alignment targets for the generator’s features ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , as the latent space in which diffusion operates ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , or as intermediate generation targets ( Li et al., 2024a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 扩散变换器已成为图像生成的标准主干模型（Peebles & Xie, 2023；Ma et al., 2024；Esser et al., 2024）。 在这些模型中，条件信息通过一个固定接口输入：一个类别标签或文本提示被嵌入一次，并在每个去噪步骤中重复使用相同的条件。 生成器需要自行判断该条件对当前图像意味着什么，随着其状态从噪声逐渐转变为干净的样本。 近期的研究将预训练的视觉表示引入了这一流程，用作生成器特征的对齐目标（Yu et al., 2025）、扩散模型运作的潜在空间（Zheng et al., 2026），或作为中间生成目标（Li et al., 2024a）。

paragraphs.en: In all of these, the condition itself stays fixed while the image evolves. We ask: can the condition itself be predicted from the current noisy image, at every denoising step?

paragraphs.en: NEPA trains a Transformer to predict the next embedding in a sequence, rather than to reconstruct pixels or discrete tokens ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Unlike a feature extractor, such a model is predictive by construction: its outputs are estimates of embeddings it has not yet seen. In generation, the sequence runs from the condition through the noisy image to the clean image, so the clean image is what comes next, and its predicted embeddings are a natural candidate for what a generator should condition on.
paragraphs.zh: NEPA 训练一个 Transformer 来预测序列中的下一个嵌入，而不是重建像素或离散标记（Xu 等人，2025）。 与特征提取器不同，这类模型在结构上就是预测性的：其输出是对尚未见过的嵌入的估计。 在生成过程中，序列从条件开始，经过噪声图像，最终得到清晰图像，因此清晰图像是接下来要生成的内容，而对其预测的嵌入自然成为生成器应基于的条件。

sents.zh: NEPA 训练一个 Transformer 来预测序列中的下一个嵌入，而不是重建像素或离散标记（Xu 等人，2025）。

sents.en: Unlike a feature extractor, such a model is predictive by construction: its outputs are estimates of embeddings it has not yet seen.

paragraphs.en: We answer this question with Embedding Conditioned Generation (ECG): a DiT generator is conditioned on the embeddings predicted by a frozen NEPA model instead of on the raw condition, and the NEPA model is queried at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. The NEPA model is trained with Multi-Embedding Prediction (MEP), which extends NEPA to predict the next several embeddings at once, as multi-token prediction does for tokens in language modeling ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ) ; it reads the condition and the noisy image and predicts the embeddings of the clean image (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过嵌入条件生成（ECG）来回答这个问题：DiT 生成器以冻结的 NEPA 模型所预测的嵌入为条件，而不是以原始条件为条件；并且 NEPA 模型在每次去噪步骤中都会被查询，因此条件信号能够适应当前的噪声状态。 NEPA 模型采用多嵌入预测（MEP）进行训练，该方法将 NEPA 扩展为一次性预测接下来的多个嵌入，就像多标记预测在语言建模中对标记所做的那样（Gloeckle 等人，2024）；它读取条件和噪声图像，并预测干净图像的嵌入（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: On class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 , we compare NEPA predictions with networks of the same size trained in other ways, and study the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction and the scaling of both models. Combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 .
paragraphs.zh: 在类条件 ImageNet 256 × 256 数据集上，我们将 NEPA 的预测结果与采用其他训练方式、但规模相同的网络进行比较，并研究多嵌入预测的设计以及两种模型的扩展性。 结合 REPA 后，我们的最终模型 NEPA-DiT-XL 实现了 1.32 的 FID 值。

sents.en: On class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 , we compare NEPA predictions with networks of the same size trained in other ways, and study the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction and the scaling of both models.

paragraphs.en: We highlight the main contributions of this paper below:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在下文重点介绍本文的主要贡献：

paragraphs.en: We propose Embedding Conditioned Generation, which conditions a DiT generator on the clean embeddings predicted by a NEPA model from the condition and the noisy image, recomputed at every denoising step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“嵌入条件生成”方法，该方法将 DiT 生成器的条件设定为：由 NEPA 模型根据输入条件和含噪图像预测出的干净嵌入向量，并在每次去噪步骤中重新计算该向量。

paragraphs.en: We train the NEPA model with Multi-Embedding Prediction, which extends NEPA to predict the embeddings of the whole clean image at once.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用多嵌入预测方法训练 NEPA 模型，该方法将 NEPA 扩展为能够一次性预测整张干净图像的嵌入表示。

paragraphs.en: On class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 , we study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models; combined with REPA, NEPA-DiT-XL reaches an FID of 1.32.
paragraphs.zh: 在类别条件化的 ImageNet 256 × 256 数据集上，我们研究了生成器的条件设置、多嵌入预测的设计以及两个模型的扩展性；结合 REPA 后，NEPA-DiT-XL 的 FID 值达到了 1.32。

paragraphs.en: Denoising diffusion models have become a dominant framework for image generation ( Song & Ermon, 2019 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021b ; Nichol & Dhariwal, 2021 ; Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ) , supported by faster samplers ( Song et al., 2021a ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ) and by flow-based formulations ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Latent diffusion models operate in the latent space of a pretrained autoencoder to reduce the computational cost ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Esser et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Yao et al., 2025 ) , while diffusion transformers replace U-Net denoisers with more scalable architectures ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Bao et al., 2023 ) . Text-to-image models further improve these systems through stronger architectures, flow-based objectives, and text conditioning ( Nichol et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Balaji et al., 2023 ; Podell et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024a ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024c ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) . Beyond synthesis, diffusion models have been adapted to text-guided image manipulation and editing ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Hertz et al., 2023 ; Mokady et al., 2023 ; Brooks et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) , to spatially controlled generation ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , and to temporally consistent video generation ( Ho et al., 2022 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) . Pretrained visual representations have been brought into this pipeline as generation targets ( Li et al., 2024a ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Kouzelis et al., 2025b ) , alignment signals for diffusion features ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Leng et al., 2025 ) , and the generative latent space ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) . In these models, the class or text condition is injected by adaLN ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) or joint attention ( Esser et al., 2024 ) and stays fixed across denoising steps. Unified multimodal models condition a diffusion decoder on embeddings produced by a language model ( Sun et al., 2024b ; Ge et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , but these embeddings are likewise computed once before sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪扩散模型已成为图像生成的主流框架（Song & Ermon, 2019；Ho et al., 2020；Song et al., 2021b；Nichol & Dhariwal, 2021；Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021），并得到了更快速采样器（Song et al., 2021a；Lu et al., 2022；Song et al., 2023）和基于流的建模方法（Lipman et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2023；Ma et al., 2024；Huang et al., 2026）的支持。 潜在扩散模型在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中运行，以降低计算成本（Rombach et al., 2022；Esser et al., 2021；Chen et al., 2025b；Yao et al., 2025），而扩散Transformer则用更具扩展性的架构替代了U-Net去噪器（Peebles & Xie, 2023；Bao et al., 2023）。 文本到图像模型通过更强大的架构、基于流的目标函数和文本条件约束进一步改进了这些系统（Nichol et al., 2022；Ramesh et al., 2022；Saharia et al., 2022；Balaji et al., 2023；Podell et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2024b；Chen et al., 2024a；Esser et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024c；Peng et al., 2025；Xie et al., 2025；Xie et al., 2026）。 除了合成任务，扩散模型还被应用于文本引导的图像操控与编辑（Meng et al., 2022；Hertz et al., 2023；Mokady et al., 2023；Brooks et al., 2023；Xu et al., 2023；Xu et al., 2024）、空间可控生成（Zhang et al., 2023）以及时间一致的视频生成（Ho et al., 2022；Guo et al., 2024；Xia et al., 2024）。 预训练的视觉表示已被引入这一流程，用作生成目标（Li et al., 2024a；Wu et al., 2025；Kouzelis et al., 2025b）、扩散特征的对齐信号（Yu et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026b；Jiang et al., 2026；Tian et al., 2026；Leng et al., 2025）以及生成性潜在空间（Zheng et al., 2026；Tong et al., 2026；Singh et al., 2026）。 在这些模型中，类别或文本条件通过 adaLN（Peebles & Xie, 2023）或联合注意力机制（Esser et al., 2024）注入，并在整个去噪过程中保持固定。 统一的跨模态模型将语言模型生成的嵌入作为扩散解码器的条件输入（Sun et al., 2024b；Ge et al., 2024；Pan et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2025a），但这些嵌入同样在采样前仅计算一次。

paragraphs.en: Self-supervised visual learning has progressed from handcrafted pretext tasks ( Doersch et al., 2015 ; Noroozi & Favaro, 2016 ; Zhang et al., 2016 ; Gidaris et al., 2018 ) to contrastive and self-distillation methods ( van den Oord et al., 2019 ; He et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2020 ; Grill et al., 2020 ; Caron et al., 2020 ; Caron et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ) and to masked reconstruction approaches that predict pixels, tokens, or visual features ( Bao et al., 2022 ; He et al., 2022 ; Xie et al., 2022 ; Wei et al., 2022 ; Baevski et al., 2022 ) . Generative image models instead learn by predicting discrete or continuous visual tokens, either autoregressively or through masked and progressively refined prediction ( van den Oord et al., 2017 ; Esser et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2022 ; Lee et al., 2022 ; Chang et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024b ) . However, pixel and discrete-token prediction can emphasize low-level details or tokenizer-specific structure. Predictive representation learning avoids direct reconstruction by predicting targets in a learned embedding space: JEPA and I-JEPA predict masked target representations from visible context, and V-JEPA extends this principle to spatiotemporal prediction ( LeCun, 2022 ; Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . NEPA further combines representation prediction with causal modeling by replacing the next-token prediction of language models ( Radford et al., 2019 ; Brown et al., 2020 ) with next-embedding prediction ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Our Multi-Embedding Prediction extends NEPA to predict several embeddings at once, analogous to multi-token prediction in language modeling ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: NEPA predicts one next embedding at a time. In language modeling, predicting several future tokens at once improves over next-token prediction ( Gloeckle et al., 2024 ) . Predicting one embedding at a time is similarly limiting when the next embeddings form a group that is needed together, such as the patch embeddings of an image. Multi-Embedding Prediction (MEP) extends NEPA to predict the next K K embeddings simultaneously from the same context. paragraphs.en: Generation produces an image through a sequence of states: from the condition, through a noisy image, to the clean image. We write this as a sequence of embeddings, the condition, then the N N patch embeddings of the noisy image, then the N N patch embeddings of the clean image. In this sequence, the clean embeddings are the next N N embeddings after the condition and the noisy image, and we train a NEPA model to predict them with MEP, taking K = N K=N . The sequence is ordered by generation state rather than by patch position, so the embedding that follows noisy patch i i is clean patch i i . MEP predicts all N N embeddings of the clean image in one forward pass, each from the full context of the condition and the noisy image. The model is defined by three choices: the sequence and its readout, an attention mask with the condition as a causal prefix, and an InfoNCE loss.
paragraphs.zh: 生成过程通过一系列状态产生图像：从条件出发，经过一个含噪图像，最终得到干净图像。 我们将这一过程表示为一系列嵌入：首先是条件，接着是含噪图像的 N N 个块嵌入，最后是干净图像的 N N 个块嵌入。 在这一序列中，干净的嵌入位于条件与含噪图像之后的下一个 N N 个嵌入位置，我们训练一个 NEPA 模型，利用 MEP 预测这些嵌入，其中 K = N K=N 。 该序列的排列依据是生成状态而非块的位置，因此紧随含噪块 i i 的嵌入是干净块 i i 。 MEP 在一次前向传播中预测干净图像的全部 N N 个嵌入，每个嵌入都基于条件和含噪图像的完整上下文进行预测。 该模型由三个选择定义：序列及其读出机制、以条件为因果前缀的注意力掩码，以及一个 InfoNCE 损失函数。

paragraphs.en: Loss. We compare the InfoNCE loss of Section 3.3 with two regression losses, negative cosine similarity and mean squared error (MSE), which pull each prediction toward its own target without contrasting it against the others. InfoNCE gives the best FID, 31.36 against 35.23 for MSE and 37.82 for cosine similarity (Table 1 ). ImageNet-1K accuracy of the fine-tuned NEPA model follows the opposite order. InfoNCE must tell each patch apart from the other patches of the same image, so its predictions keep patch-level detail that helps generation; the regression losses favor smoother, more global predictions, which help classification instead.
paragraphs.zh: 损失函数。 我们将第 3.3 节中的 InfoNCE 损失与两种回归损失——负余弦相似度和均方误差（MSE）——进行了比较；后两者会将每个预测值向其自身目标拉近，而不会将其与其他预测值进行对比。 InfoNCE 取得了最佳的 FID 分数：31.36，优于 MSE 的 35.23 和余弦相似度的 37.82（见表 1）。 经过微调的 NEPA 模型在 ImageNet-1K 上的准确率则呈现出相反的顺序。 InfoNCE 必须使每个图像块与其他同一图像中的图像块区分开来，因此其预测能够保留有助于生成的图像块级细节；而回归损失则更倾向于生成更平滑、更具全局性的预测，这反而有助于分类任务。

paragraphs.en: Scaling the NEPA model and the generator. Beyond the small-scale setting, Table 8 scales both models, training all nine combinations of NEPA-B/L/XL and DiT-B/L/XL, each for 400K iterations and evaluated with 64 ODE steps without guidance. FID decreases monotonically along both axes. Scaling the generator from DiT-B to DiT-XL improves FID by about 14 points for every NEPA model, and scaling the NEPA model from NEPA-B to NEPA-XL improves FID by about 5 points for every generator. paragraphs.en: We have shown that predictive embeddings can serve as the condition of an image generator. In Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned at every denoising step on the clean-image embeddings that a NEPA model, trained with Multi-Embedding Prediction, predicts from the condition and the current noisy image. On ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 , combined with REPA, NEPA-DiT-XL reaches an FID of 1.32 with the 250-step SDE sampler and 1.57 with the 96-step ODE sampler, trained with about a third of REPA’s compute even though it trains and runs two networks. Code and model weights will be released. Future work is discussed in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经证明，预测性嵌入可以作为图像生成器的条件。 在嵌入条件生成中，DiT 生成器在每个去噪步骤都以干净图像的嵌入为条件，而这些嵌入是由一个经过多嵌入预测训练的 NEPA 模型根据当前条件和当前含噪图像预测出来的。 在 ImageNet 256 × 256 上，结合 REPA，NEPA-DiT-XL 使用 250 步的 SDE 采样器时达到 FID 1.32，使用 96 步的 ODE 采样器时达到 1.57，尽管它需要训练和运行两个网络，但训练所需的计算量仅为 REPA 的大约三分之一。 代码和模型权重将会发布。 未来的工作将在附录 B 中讨论。

paragraphs.en: Relation to RepFusion. RepFusion ( Pan et al., 2026a ) also conditions a diffusion transformer on the outputs of a model that reads the noisy input at every denoising step. It builds on two existing components: the latent space of a representation autoencoder ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , which it adopts so that noisy latents are compatible with pretrained language-model priors, and a pretrained multimodal LLM, which it repurposes as the encoder of noisy representations. Our NEPA model depends on neither. It is trained from scratch with Multi-Embedding Prediction directly on the latents of a standard VAE, so the conditioning interface is defined by a training objective rather than by an existing model. The same recipe can therefore be applied to any Transformer as the NEPA model and to any generator that accepts conditioning tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 与 RepFusion 的关系。 RepFusion（Pan 等人，2026a）同样将扩散变换器的条件建立在某个模型之上，该模型在每个去噪步骤中都会读取含噪声的输入。 它基于两个现有组件：表示自编码器的潜在空间（Zheng 等人，2026），通过采用该空间，含噪声的潜在变量可以与预训练语言模型的先验兼容；以及一个预训练的多模态大型语言模型，它被重新用作含噪声表示的编码器。 我们的 NEPA 模型不依赖这两者中的任何一项。 它从零开始使用多嵌入预测方法直接对标准 VAE 的潜在变量进行训练，因此其条件接口是由训练目标定义的，而非由现有模型定义。 因此，同样的方法可以应用于任何作为 NEPA 模型的 Transformer，以及任何接受条件标记的生成器。

paragraphs.en: Relation to DDT. DDT ( Wang et al., 2026b ) also splits the generator into a condition encoder that reads the noisy latent and a velocity decoder conditioned on the encoder output. The two are trained jointly: the encoder is supervised indirectly through the velocity loss of the decoder, together with a REPA alignment to DINOv2 features. Our NEPA model is instead trained separately to predict the clean embeddings of the image and is then frozen, so the condition is a representation learned with its own objective rather than an intermediate feature of the generator. DDT also shares the encoder output between adjacent denoising steps to accelerate sampling, and Table 14 studies the corresponding choice for our NEPA model.
paragraphs.zh: 与 DDT 的关系。 DDT（Wang 等人，2026b）也将生成器拆分为一个读取噪声潜在条件的条件编码器和一个以编码器输出为条件的速度解码器。 两者是联合训练的：编码器通过解码器的速度损失间接接受监督，同时还需要与 DINOv2 特征的 REPA 对齐。 相比之下，我们的 NEPA 模型是分开训练以预测图像的干净嵌入，之后会被冻结，因此其条件是通过自身目标学习到的表示，而非生成器的中间特征。 DDT 还会在相邻的去噪步骤间共享编码器输出以加速采样，表 14 研究了我们 NEPA 模型对此的相应选择。

sents.en: Relation to DDT.
sents.zh: 与 DDT 的关系。

sents.en: DDT ( Wang et al., 2026b ) also splits the generator into a condition encoder that reads the noisy latent and a velocity decoder conditioned on the encoder output.
sents.zh: DDT（Wang 等人，2026b）也将生成器拆分为一个读取噪声潜在条件的条件编码器和一个以编码器输出为条件的速度解码器。

Table 7 includes, in the same setting, a network of the same architecture trained end to end with the generator by flow matching, and the same network pretrained as a flow-matching model and then frozen.

paragraphs.en: Text conditions. Text-to-image models either encode the prompt once with a separate text encoder ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Esser et al., 2024 ) , which cannot adapt to the evolving noisy image and often fixes the length of the condition, or process the prompt together with the image in a single unified model ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , where the condition and the image share one backbone. A NEPA model could instead read the whole prompt before the noisy image and predict the clean image embeddings from both, as it does for class labels in this paper.
paragraphs.zh: 文本条件。 文本到图像模型要么使用独立的文本编码器对提示词进行一次性编码（Saharia 等，2022；Chen 等，2024b；Esser 等，2024），这种方式无法适应不断变化的含噪图像，且通常会使条件的长度固定不变；要么将提示词与图像一同处理于一个统一的模型中（Deng 等，2025），其中条件与图像共享同一个主干网络。 相比之下，NEPA 模型可以在读取含噪图像之前先读取整个提示词，并基于两者预测干净图像的嵌入表示，就像本文中对类别标签所做的那样。

Since the NEPA model is an autoregressive Transformer, a single NEPA model could in principle serve both as a language model with an output head and as the conditioning model of a DiT generator. paragraphs.en: Further implementation details. Throughout the experiments, the generator matches DiT ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) in depth, width, and number of heads, but uses MM-DiT blocks ( Esser et al., 2024 ) : the first blocks are two-stream and process the predicted embeddings and the latent tokens with separate weights, and the remaining blocks are single-stream blocks on the concatenated sequence. The NEPA model is kept frozen when training the generator. We use mixed precision (bfloat16) with gradient clipping at 1.0 for both stages, and keep an EMA of the generator weights with decay 0.9999. The timestep of the generator is sampled from a logit-normal distribution with zero mean and unit variance ( Esser et al., 2024 ) . We use the stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse VAE ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) for encoding images during training and the stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-ema VAE for decoding samples. For the REPA projector, we use a three-layer MLP with SiLU activations and hidden dimension 2,048, following Yu et al. (2025) . We provide a detailed hyperparameter setup in Tables 11 and 12 .
paragraphs.zh: 更多实现细节。 在整个实验过程中，生成器的深度、宽度和头数与 DiT（Peebles & Xie, 2023）一致，但使用了 MM-DiT 块（Esser et al., 2024）：前几个块是双流结构，使用独立的权重处理预测嵌入和潜在标记；其余块则是基于拼接序列的单流块。 在训练生成器时，NEPA 模型保持冻结状态。 我们在两个阶段均使用混合精度（bfloat16），并将梯度裁剪值设为 1.0，同时以 0.9999 的衰减率维护生成器权重的 EMA。 生成器的时间步长从均值为零、方差为一的对数正态分布中采样（Esser et al., 2024）。 在训练期间，我们使用 stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse VAE（Rombach et al., 2022）对图像进行编码，并使用 stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-ema VAE 对样本进行解码。 对于 REPA 投影器，我们采用 Yu et al.（2025）的方法，使用一个包含 SiLU 激活函数和 2,048 维隐藏层的三层 MLP。 我们在表 11 和表 12 中提供了详细的超参数设置。
